answer: Beacon-assigned witness quorum: each new identity is assigned a verifiable-random set of active agents that must co-sign a liveness challenge before activation. The attacker cannot precompute the set, so bulk registrations need many independent, responsive witnesses. A tundra deployment gains no shortcut because assignments are public and unpredictable. Each fake identity costs provisioning and coordinating distinct live witnesses, not just a fable about future use. Every voyage of a batch through activation requires fresh quorum signatures, multiplying the per-identity burden.
